summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed via Form 6-K a buyback of its own shares under Article 64 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law. On 09/28/2026, CPSA bought 100,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$1,998.67 per share for AR$199,867,084, while wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. bought 20,000 ADRs on the NYSE at US$12.23 per ADR for US$244,795.20, both settling 09/29/2026. Combined purchases stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily trading volume. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock detailed; watch ongoing repurchase pace and ADR/local price spread.
